title: Rabbi Berekhyah bar Abba bar Kahana
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: “He spoke in the name of Rabbi Elazar” is cited in Bamidbar Rabbah 9:48. Hyman calls this a printing error. He identifies Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 3:4 as the source and reports the reading “Rabbi Berekhyah in the name of Rabbi Abba bar Kahana.” Hyman says that the author of Otzar Yisrael erred in citing him.

notes.text: In the consulted Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 3:4, Berekhyah and Abba bar Kahana are named before the attribution to Rabbi Liezer. The witness has no attribution formula between the first two names. Hyman’s proposed reading and his judgment about the printing are preserved in the text.
